'''[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]''' constructed his [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' while under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]].<ref name="Star Wars 33">[[Star Wars 33|''Star Wars'' 33]]</ref> Vos wielded his lightsaber aggressively,<ref name="Star Wars 19" /> After becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Vos continued to use the lightsaber, even during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

[[File:QuinlanVos-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|300px|Quinlan Vos wielding his lightsaber with the green blade ignited]]
When Vos became a double-agent for the Jedi,<ref name="Jedi: Shaak Ti">''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]''</ref> he brushed against the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], becoming one of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] most trusted acolytes. After being manipulated by Dooku to murder his own [[Tinté Vos|aunt]] with his lightsaber,<ref name="Jedi: Dooku">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref> Vos fully convinced Dooku of his fall to the dark side. As a reward for his actions during the [[Raid on Kiffu|mission]] Vos was sent to recover an ancient [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], Dooku removed the red Sith crystal from the holocron and presented it to Vos stating that it used to power [[Darth Andeddu]]'s lightsaber.<ref name="Republic 63">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref>

After breaking free of the dark side, Vos returned to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Republic 69">[[Republic 69|''Republic'' 69]]</ref> and replaced the red crystal with his original green crystal and performed several deeds for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CWA 9">{{CWACite|9|Life Below}}</ref> After the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] freed [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] from prison, Vos teamed up with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and headed for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. After visiting Ziro's mother, [[Mama]], the two headed for [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], where they battled Bane and [[Todo 360/Legends|his droid]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />

During the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege of Saleucami]]<ref name="Republic 74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Vos used the lightsaber to kill fallen Jedi [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]],<ref name="Republic 77">[[Republic 77|''Republic'' 77]]</ref> after the latter killed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]].<ref name="Republic 75">[[Republic 75|''Republic'' 75]]</ref> After the siege, Vos was given orders to go to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], along with Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].<ref name="Republic 81">[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]]</ref> When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], as the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] Darth Sidious, issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="EP III">{{Film|III}}</ref> Vos was still stationed on the Wookiee planet when Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Unduli]] was shot down and Yoda escaped the planet. Vos used his weapon to escape the Republic forces.<ref name="Star Wars 45">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref>
